kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.kb_gosip_sumur: washing and gossiping at the well
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.kb_kakek_catur: playing chess at the tea house
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.kb_takhayul_si: staying home on an unlucky day
kultivator.kota42.bakat.aura: A faint aura surrounds the child when seated
kultivator.kota42.bakat.kabur: Ran away from home to find a sect
kultivator.kota42.bakat.restu: The family has given its blessing
kultivator.kota42.bakat.sikap.bangga: Proud, wants the child in a sect
kultivator.kota42.bakat.sikap.menolak: Refusing, wants an heir for the business
kultivator.kota42.bakat.sikap.ragu: Doubtful, needs persuading or a blessing gift
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.adu_jangkrik: Squats in an alley around a cricket jar with friends, cheering and slapping their foreheads.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.burung_sangk: Walks a caged bird at dawn, hangs it on a branch and sits listening to it sing.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.dermawan.des: Gives coins to beggars and sweets to children at midday.
Washes clothes at the well while whispering and laughing; any news that passes the well spreads three times faster.
Plays xiangqi under the tree morning and afternoon; other elders watch, point and shake their heads.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.kutu_buku.de: Reads while walking and reads again into the night; a scholar's skill grows faster.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.layang_layan: Flies kites on the field in the windy seasons.
Sits at the tea house in the afternoon, sipping and judging every brew.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pekerja_kera: First to open the workplace and last to close it; skill grows fast.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pelit.desc: Haggles three rounds and counts coins again and again before paying.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pelukis_gula: Paints sugar candy on the square on market and rest day afternoons; children queue up.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pemabuk.desc: Spends the nights at the wine shop, cup never dry; sometimes staggers home, sometimes sleeps on a street bench till dawn.
Plays the erhu on the porch at dusk; neighbours who hear it feel calmer.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pemalas.desc: Wakes two hours late, yawning, and naps again at noon; skill grows slowly.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pemancing.de: Fishes at the waterside in the afternoon; now and then lifts a fish and carries it home.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pemarah.desc: Quick to anger, jabs a finger at traders or passing children; makes enemies fast.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pemuja_kulti: Follows passing cultivators of Foundation and above in awe, begging to see a technique.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penabung.des: Goes to the counting house on the third day of the week and works the abacus; the household prospers.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pencerita_an: Tells stories at dusk to children sitting in a ring on the floor; the town's children are happier for it.
Burns incense and bows at the temple every morning.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penggemar_op: Watches the shadow theatre at night, humming and clapping.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pengintip.de: Peeks over fences on tiptoe; knows every rumour and is the best source of news for the player.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penjudi.desc: Throws dice at the gambling table at night; the debts become gossip and the household grows poorer.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penyair.desc: Writes verse at the pavilion by day and declaims at the tavern by night.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penyapu_jala: Sweeps the street in front of the house at dawn.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.penyulam.des: Embroiders on the porch in the afternoon and sells the work on market day.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.pesolek.desc: Strolls slowly through the market, checking a hand mirror and eyeing the cloth stalls.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.tai_chi.desc: Practises tai chi on the square before sunrise, led by the eldest; keeps the body healthy.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.takhayul.des: Reads the almanac each morning and burns incense at the door; stays home on unlucky days.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.tari_kipas.d: Dances the yangge in a line with a fan or a scarf at dawn and dusk; always joins the festival parade.
kultivator.kota42.kebiasaan.teman_kucing: Feeds and plays with the town cats in the afternoon; one of them has made its home there.
Dozes off on a shady bench after lunch.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.ikut_anak: Our child lives in %s, sir. It is time we joined them.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.murung: Life in the old town was too hard, sir. May fortune be kinder in %s.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.nganggur: We are moving to %s, sir. There is work there.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.nikah: I am married, sir! I am going with my spouse to %s.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.serbuan: Our house was ruined in the raid, sir. We are going to relatives in %s.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.sesak: Our house is too crowded, sir. I will try my luck in %s.
kultivator.kota42.pindah.ucap.takut: Our town is not safe anymore, sir. We are fleeing to %s.
